# Navigation Drawer

A navigation drawer appears as a side panel revealing navigation options such as links, collapsible sub-menus, badges, and dividers. Supports LTR/RTL, multiple background themes, and accessibility.

**Stylesheet:** `components/nav-drawer/nav-drawer.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/nav-drawer.js` (classes `NavDrawerManager`). Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.
